title: Procurement Decision Graph: Model Substitutability Signal & Fielding Playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Produce an operational decision graph and playbook that product, sales, and procurement teams can use to evaluate model substitutability during outages, price shocks, or procurement negotiations. The deliverable includes (1) a signal taxonomy with prioritized observability inputs, (2) a decision graph mapping signals to recommended fallback actions and procurement triggers, (3) a lightweight field playbook for sales/solutions to run probes, and (4) an integration plan for the Model Catalog and Console alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Decision graph (visual + JSON ruleset) that covers at least three substitution scenarios: latency degradation, model availability outage, and price spike
Signal taxonomy enumerated with data sources, estimated precision, and ownership for each signal (e.g., model-availability-feed, regional latency SLOs, customer success reports)
Operational playbook with 5 step-by-step probes for solutions/sales to validate substitution before escalating to procurement
Integration spec for Console alerting and Model Catalog tags (fields, thresholds, recommended fallback models)
Stakeholder signoff from SRE, Sales Engineering, and Procurement on the playbook and decision thresholds
tasks: Inventory existing telemetry: latency SLO metrics, regional capacity indicators, model variant availability feeds — owner: Rohit (3 days)
Draft signal taxonomy and rank by signal freshness, noise, and lead time — owner: PM research (4 days)
Prototype decision graph (Mermaid + JSON rules) for three scenarios and run tabletop exercises with SRE — owner: Product (5 days)
Create field playbook (templates, checklist, canned prompts for customers) and pilot with two AE teams — owner: Solutions Eng (7 days)
Console integration spec + alerting wireframe (Model Catalog tags, alert thresholds, runbooks) — owner: Console PM + Eng (6 days)
Run 1-week pilot with two SMB customers to validate friction and false positive rate — owner: Customer Success (8 days)
Finalize documentation and record a 30-min cross-functional walkthrough for Sales/Procurement — owner: Ava (2 days)
risks: Signal noise causing unnecessary failovers — mitigations: experimental false-positive throttle, confidence scoring
Incomplete telemetry in some regions — mitigations: conservative thresholds and manual confirmation steps in playbook
Procurement/legal timeline mismatch if playbook recommends reserved capacity — mitigations: decision path includes business-impact scoring for commit vs hosted fallback
